children: RNS Number : 0492W  Sunrise Resources Plc  23 September 2026
The Company advises that it has received the attached TR-1 Notification of Major Holding from Executive Chairman, Mr Patrick Cheetham.
The TR-1 form discloses the number of ordinary shares in the capital of the Company in which Mr Cheetham has a direct and indirect interest, being 992,995,526 ordinary shares.

This notified holding has increased by 100,000,000 ordinary shares since the last notification made on 17 April 2026 and follows Mr Cheetham’s participation in the Placing as announced on 17 September 2026. Mr Cheetham’s holding now represents 8.63% of the issued capital following the issue of the Placing Shares earlier today.
Capitalised terms used in this announcement have the same meaning as used in the announcement of the Placing made on 17 September 2026

Beaumont Cornish Limited (“Beaumont Cornish”) is the Company’s Nominated Adviser and is authorised and regulated by the FCA. Beaumont Cornish’s responsibilities as the Company’s Nominated Adviser, including a responsibility to advise and guide the Company on its responsibilities under the AIM Rules for Companies and AIM Rules for Nominated Advisers, are owed solely to the London Stock Exchange. Beaumont Cornish is not acting for and will not be responsible to any other persons for providing protections afforded to customers of Beaumont Cornish nor for advising them in relation to the proposed arrangements described in this announcement or any matter referred to in it.
